family_decision: For an existing San Antonio family itinerary, retain an indoor alternative and check a near-departure forecast without treating the weekly page review as current weather.
hypothesis: An independent official structured API with explicit reuse conditions can support short-lived weather checks, but cannot establish global coverage or make weekly forecast storage trustworthy.

sources.section_update_label: Known Issues: Updated 3/24/2026; not the publication date of the entire document
sources.summary: API data are described as free open data. An identifying User-Agent is required; documentation mentions future API keys, not current key onboarding. Numeric rate limits are unpublished. Cache-aware JSON formats and coordinate-to-grid discovery are documented. Twelve-hour and hourly forecasts cover the next seven days; point/grid mappings can change. API times use ISO8601. Observations can lag upstream processing.

NWS material is generally public domain unless otherwise marked. Do not claim ownership, imply agency endorsement or present altered material as official. Third-party content has separate rights. Dates matter; timely Internet delivery is not guaranteed. Appropriate-use guidance calls for needed data only, update-aware request cycles, error handling and restrained retries; the six-hour forecast example is not a universal TTL.

Source attribution may identify NOAA/NWS data while clearly separating it from the third-party display. Government data cannot be claimed as copyrighted private content. No logo license or endorsement is inferred.

existing_fit.job: Existing heat/weather pivot and linked forecast check; no new weather URL or demand transfer from hotel queries.
existing_fit.gap: Live forecast integration and expiry behavior are not implemented or validated. This is a maintenance-source qualification, not a discovered public factual error.

scope_verdict.coverage: Pilot only the existing US San Antonio destination after exact coordinate/endpoint validation. No non-US or universal coverage claim.
scope_verdict.independent_of_original_holds: Weather data do not replace Dana room/fee or Garfield admission facts. Those three source-policy holds remain unchanged; no alternate retrieval or bypass.
scope_verdict.next_eligible_run: Next actual run inside the authorized window after this research passes review/release, provided the adapter is registered and current published access conditions remain unchanged.
scope_verdict.owner: Master operator with a different independent read-only reviewer
scope_verdict.remaining_gate: Register an API-specific adapter and exact point/request scope; inspect current OpenAPI schema and applicable endpoint access/response/cache rules; test deterministic parsing, units, nulls, geographic and validity bounds, cache expiry and denial/no-replay behavior; independently review before a bounded native pilot. Do not relax the old HTML guard to admit API data.
scope_verdict.stop_condition: Stop on an access denial/challenge, unsupported location, missing schema/date/unit, expired data or a conflicting source record. No alternate host, proxy, repeated unchanged denial, automatic publication or safety inference.

proposed_adapter_contract.discovery: /points/{latitude},{longitude}; follow only a separately approved exact returned forecast URL after validating origin, path and location binding
proposed_adapter_contract.identity: Unique application User-Agent identifying familytripwise.com; do not invent or publish a personal contact email
proposed_adapter_contract.method: Deterministic JSON parser; no LLM required for structured period/date/unit/null handling
proposed_adapter_contract.field_names: Internal proposed envelope names, not asserted NWS JSON property names; confirm exact OpenAPI types first
proposed_adapter_contract.refresh: Weekly source/schema health may be part of existing maintenance. Forecast checks require demand-driven source-cache/validity-aware expiry; weekly storage alone is rejected. No additional scheduler selected.
proposed_adapter_contract.retention: Proposed private short-lived normalized facts and response validators; public Git only bounded dated research metadata. No visitor exact location, saved family dates, full source archives or copied advisory feed. Retention implementation requires review.
proposed_adapter_contract.nulls: Missing precipitation is unknown, not dry; missing temperature is unknown, not zero. Do not extrapolate beyond the returned horizon or substitute observed past conditions for a forecast.
proposed_adapter_contract.authority: Keep data attribution separate from Family Tripwise planning interpretation. Forecasts are predictions, not actual conditions or a promise an attraction opens or an outdoor plan is suitable. Link official current advisories; do not summarize them into an all-clear.

steps.result: Existing San Antonio itinerary owns the pivot and forecast link; no new URL selected.
Current NWS API documentation explicitly describes open data; reuse conditions and attribution reviewed separately.
Seven-day documented horizon is near-term only; later dates remain unknown, not a seasonal prediction.
REJECT weekly-only current forecast. Cache/date/period validity and endpoint schema remain adapter gates.
No attraction availability, room acceptance, stroller practicality, observed weather or safety claim follows from forecast data.
Future pilot must preserve unknown/null/denied states and official source handoff without stale all-clear or tool bypass.
Candidate registered API adapter, not live integration, a refreshed page or proof of weekly/global readiness.

maintainer_task.result: SOURCE_DOCUMENTATION_GATE_QUALIFIED; endpoint/schema/native pilot and user-facing usefulness remain untested

confidence: High for observed documentation and separation of policy classes; unknown native endpoint availability, exact schema, location coverage, product usefulness and operational reliability.
reusable_lesson: Weekly maintenance is not a single freshness clock. A reusable evidence system needs both source-policy/schema upkeep and field-specific validity; short-lived forecasts must expire independently of stable page comparisons.
falsification_trigger: Documentation/use conditions change; exact endpoint denies; returned mapping/location differs; period expires or predates retrieval; omitted values become zero; display confuses predictions with observations or safety; unresolved critical maintenance backlog grows during expansion.
